Approaching Earth

Select any planet to explore it

This device cannot run the 3D experience, so here is the journey in words. Open it on a device with WebGL to fly it.

Our universe.
One endless journey.

Explore the worlds that make up our solar system.

Earth and its Moon

From here the Moon comes into view, 384,400 km away. Thirty Earths would fit in the gap between them.

Four worlds of rock

Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars keep close to the Sun. They are small, dense and solid, built from rock and metal.

Mars

Rust-red deserts, a canyon as long as a continent and the tallest volcano we know of. Earth has already shrunk to a small blue disc in the distance.

Jupiter

More than twice the mass of every other planet combined. Its Great Red Spot is a storm wider than Earth.

Saturn

Rings of ice and rock reach 282,000 km from the planet, yet the main rings are only about ten metres thick.

Uranus and Neptune

Two ice giants in the cold and the dark. Sunlight needs about four hours to reach Neptune.

Eight worlds, one star

Every planet circling the Sun at once. Select any world to visit it.

Space is not the limit.
It’s the beginning.

The Sun is one of several hundred billion stars in the Milky Way. The light from one of them set out the year you were born, and it is arriving tonight.
